description: Change a composition's settings (Composition > Composition Settings): name, size, pixel aspect, duration, frame rate, resolution, start timecode or frame, drop-frame timecode, background, motion blur (shutter angle and phase, samples), nesting options and work area; and its Timeline switches Enable Frame Blending and Hide Shy Layers

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

dropFrame.description: Drop Frame timecode (29.97 and 59.94 fps); false is Non-Drop Frame

frameBlending.description: Timeline switch: Enable Frame Blending for the composition

motionBlur.description: Enable motion blur for the composition

preserveNestedFrameRate.description: Preserve frame rate when nested or in render queue

resolution.description: Resolution: full, half, third or quarter

resolutionFactor.description: Custom resolution: render every [x, y]th pixel

startFrame.description: Start Frame: the number shown for the first frame, when the project counts frames

startTimecode.description: Start Timecode: the time shown for the first frame, in seconds

name: set_comp_settings
title: Set Comp Settings
